facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of HT-9002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9002 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 27 May 2006 a near hit was recorded on HT-9002 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
